description: Set one MapLibre layout property on one skeleton layer of a hosted style (e.g. layer_id "road-path", property "line-cap", value "round"; null removes the property) and publish the result as a new immutable style version. Pair it with set_layer_paint for line patterns: dotted footpaths are road-path line-dasharray [0, 2] plus line-cap round. Layer ids come from list_style_layers. Returns the new version and style URL.

layer_id.description:
Skeleton layer id, e.g. "road-path". Call `list_style_layers`
for the accepted ids.

property.description:
MapLibre layout property name, e.g. "line-cap", "line-join" or
"visibility".

value.description:
The layout value (any MapLibre-valid JSON, e.g. "round"), or null
to remove the property and fall back to the skeleton's.

name: set_layer_layout

style_url.description: Immutable URL of the compiled style at this version.
